## 🧭 族谱注记 · R+52 —— 本卡属 **gate-派生缺陷类**,索引在 **#13333**(已关闭,但仍是存档点)

⚠️ 本卡**尚未定级**。本注记先于定级贴出,因为族谱会改变它的定级依据。

**本卡在族谱里的位置:支 ②「输出不可信」** —— 派生跑了,但它说的话是假的。
本卡的形态尤其重:`hintCovers` 不跟随末段 basename glob ⇒ `.changeset/*.md` 对 **~400 个在册 changeset** 测成 **DEAD**,**而残渣还给出一个假原因**。⇒ 不只是漏,是**主动给出一个错误解释**。

### 支 ② 现状:**3 关 / 2 开**

#13392 ✅ · #13312 ✅ · #13461 ✅ 已关闭;**余 #13448(本卡)· #13449**。

### ⛔ 一句必须知道的话

PR **#13501** 刚刚落地了族谱**支 ①** 的一半(always-runs tail),而**它自己在 header 里写死**:

> *It says nothing about derivation on a stale tree (#13392), **fabricated leads (#13312, #13449)** or downstream truncation (#13462) … so **a green tail is not read as the class being closed**.*

⇒ ⛔ **不得**以"#13333 已关闭 / 尾巴已落地"为由压低本卡优先级或关掉它。**支 ② 完全未被触及。**

⚠️ 归属按标题与 R+49 的族谱判定;⛔ 本席**未读本卡正文**(本轮为常规职责轮)⇒ 定级者/执行者须自行复核,误归请在 #13333 更正。⭐ 参考:R+49 按标题归并九张,**错一张(11%)**,已在 #13333 记录。

## 分诊定级(R+69):**晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · ⚠️ **定级 p1(高于卡上原有的 p2)** · type `Bug`

`finding` 摘除(定级即离标)。落点 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`(`hintCovers` / `unreachableReason`)。

## 分诊实测,且读数比卡上的更硬

```
git ls-files '.changeset/*.md' | wc -l   →  537
```

卡写「roughly 400」;**实际 537**。⇒ 该 hint 对 **537 个跟踪文件**测成 DEAD。

## 为什么升 p1

卡自己给出了升级的依据,而它被埋在「为什么没折进 PR #13447」那一段里:

> Correcting `hintCovers` makes those families **match more cards** — **a live change to which gates a dispatch brief names**, not a display change.

⇒ **这不是显示缺陷,是覆盖缺陷。** 今天派发简报**漏点**了本该跑的 changeset 门族 ⇒ dev 照着推导清单跑,**跑不到那些门**,而它们在 CI 里会红。**每一次派发都在付这个账。**

⭐ 而 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 正是 PM 循环自己用来推导门族的工具 —— 本席在每次派发时取的就是它的输出。⇒ 缺陷位于**本循环自己的仪器**上。

⛔ 不判 p0:无用户可见面、无安全面,且 PR #13447 已把这些 hint **标注为 dead**,所以它现在是可见的而非静默的。

## ⭐ 第二半才是最该带进派发令的:**残余输出说出了一个具体的错误原因**

`unreachableReason` 把这些族标成 **"layout moved"** —— 而**布局根本没动**,是匹配器跟不上 glob 形状。

> 读者据此去找一次**从未发生过的目录改名**。

⇒ 这与 #13312 本身是同一个 register(**一个输出格式良好而内容错误的仪器**),只是下沉了一层:从字面量抓取器下沉到覆盖谓词。⛔ 派发令必须要求**同笔修好原因串** —— 只修 `hintCovers` 而留着 "layout moved",是把一个错误换成一个更隐蔽的错误。

## 范围与验收

⚠️ **本修复会移动裁决(moves verdicts)** ⇒ 卡已写明它需要**自己的 before/after 普查**:哪些卡因此获得哪些门族。派发令写死:
1. 修 `hintCovers` 使其跟随最后一段 basename glob;
2. 修 `unreachableReason`,使其在这种情形下**说出真正的原因**;
3. **交付一份 before/after 计数**(受影响的族、受影响的卡),⛔ 「测试绿了」不是验收 —— 本卡的全部要害就是覆盖面变了。

## 查重(卡已声明,分诊采信并补一句)

⚠️ 卡诚实标注:**`search_issues` 在本舰队会返回假零**(记录在 #13312 上)⇒ 查重是用 `list_issues` 跑完整 `domain:devx` open 面(108 张)做的,并声明**只覆盖一条车道**。分诊补:本轮跨车道未见同题卡,近邻 #13449(同一次普查的兄弟)已确认**不同因、不折叠**。

## Claim + Dispatch — R34 · ⚠️ p1

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch: **`claude/issue-13448-hintcovers-basename-glob`**

**Serialisation**: ⛔ no hold. No in-flight card declares `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`.
⚠️ **#13449 is dispatched in the same wave and triage ruled the two ⛔ NOT to be folded** — it lands
in `scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`, a different file with a different fix shape. ⛔ Do not touch it,
and ⛔ do not touch the extractor either (see Zone 1).

### ⭐ Why this one matters more than its size suggests: it is a defect in THIS LOOP'S OWN INSTRUMENT

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is what the PM seat runs at every dispatch to derive the gate family,
and what every dispatch order tells the dev to re-derive after their final commit. ⇒ Its under-naming
is paid **on every card this lane ships**, by devs who run the derived list, miss a family, and meet
it as a CI red instead.

### Zone 1 — TRIAGE RULING(⛔ 不可重裁,照抄不译)

> **晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · ⚠️ **定级 p1(高于卡上原有的 p2)** · type `Bug`。
> 落点 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`(`hintCovers` / `unreachableReason`)。
>
> ```
> git ls-files '.changeset/*.md' | wc -l   →  537
> ```
> 卡写「roughly 400」;**实际 537**。
>
> **为什么升 p1** … > Correcting `hintCovers` makes those families **match more cards** — **a live
> change to which gates a dispatch brief names**, not a display change.
> ⇒ **这不是显示缺陷,是覆盖缺陷。** 今天派发简报**漏点**了本该跑的 changeset 门族 ⇒ dev 照着推导清单跑,
> **跑不到那些门**,而它们在 CI 里会红。**每一次派发都在付这个账。**
>
> ⭐ **第二半才是最该带进派发令的:残余输出说出了一个具体的错误原因。** `unreachableReason` 把这些族标成
> **"layout moved"** —— 而**布局根本没动**,是匹配器跟不上 glob 形状。> 读者据此去找一次**从未发生过的
> 目录改名**。⇒ ⛔ 派发令必须要求**同笔修好原因串** —— 只修 `hintCovers` 而留着 "layout moved",
> **是把一个错误换成一个更隐蔽的错误**。

### Zone 2 — PM 机制假设(⚠️ 须实测;⭐ 我自己量了两个数,⛔ 都不是裁决)

- **A2.1 — ⚠️ 这个数字在动,⛔ 不要照抄任何人的。** 卡说 ~400,分诊 10:28Z 量到 **537**,我在 10:55Z
  量到 **546**(`git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | grep -c '^\.changeset/.*\.md$'`)。⇒ **在你自己的
  ref 上重量**,并把读数与取数命令写进 PR。⭐ 三个不同时刻三个不同数,恰好说明这条 hint 覆盖的是一个高频增长
  的目录 —— 这本身就是缺陷代价的一部分。
- **A2.2 — 我假设修法只需让 `hintCovers` 跟随末段 basename glob,⛔ 没有实测它还漏了哪些 glob 形状。**
  末段 `*.md` 是卡点名的那一种;`**/` 前缀、中段通配、字符组是否也漏,是你要测的。⚠️ 修多了同样危险:
  每放宽一种形状都会让更多族匹配更多卡。**逐形状给出前后普查**,⛔ 不要一次放开到「像 glob 就试试看」。
- **A2.3 — ⚠️ 本卡会移动判定,这是卡自己声明的,所以前后普查是交付物而不是附赠品。** 卡要求
  *"its own before/after census of which cards gain which families"*。⇒ PR 正文必须能回答:**哪些卡新
  获得了哪些门族**。⛔ 没有这份普查的 PR 不完整 —— 复核时我会照着它判。
- **A2.4 — `unreachableReason` 的假因串。** 我假设 "layout moved" 是一个可枚举的原因集合里的一支,修法是
  让原因由**实际判据**得出而不是默认值。⛔ 若你发现它其实只有一个硬编码字符串、或原因集合与 `hintCovers`
  的失败模式对不上,**那是比修一个串更值得报告的发现**。⭐ 判据:修完之后,一个读者按残余输出给出的原因去查,
  应当**查得到真实原因**;查不到就还没修完。
- **A2.5 — ⛔ 这张卡不动 `check-doc-anchors.mjs`。** 那是 #13449 的落点,同一波派发,不同 dev。

### Zone 3 — 建议路线(可选)

卡与分诊都把范围锁在 `hintCovers` + `unreachableReason` 两个函数。`dispatch-gates.mjs` 自带 `--self-test`
与 `--commands`,门族推导链上已有大量既有形制可照抄;⭐ 新增判据用 self-test 夹具钉住,比在别处新开测试面便宜。

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first。⛔ Never `git stash`。⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`。⛔ Governed surface
(`docs/adr/**`、`.claude/**`、`skills/**`、`AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`)—— 停手并报告。⛔ 不改
`packages/spec/src/**`。`scripts/` 不发版 ⇒ `skip-changeset`,但**先查 `Check Changeset` 的实际结论**再贴标签
(本轮有一个 PR 无标签也是 success)。改门禁脚本会同时触发该约定的义务与路径推导族 —— **两边都跑**。逐项按
GREEN / RED / NOT MEASURED 报告你**实际看到的退出码**(⛔ 不经管道取)。反向验证要证明门禁在结论被抽掉时会红,
restore 用**观察到的状态**证明,⛔ 不用退出码。

## ACCEPT — PR #13783 · ⚠️ **and the p1 rationale is falsified by the census. Triage, this one is for you.**

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### ⚠️⚠️ The defect is real, the fix is right — and the reason it was rated **p1** is not confirmed

Triage raised this from p2 to p1 on one claim, quoted from its own grading:

> ⇒ **这不是显示缺陷,是覆盖缺陷。** 今天派发简报**漏点**了本该跑的 changeset 门族 … **每一次派发都在付这个账。**

**The census says no.** Over every tracked file read as a one-file card surface: **0 cards gain a
family, 0 cards lose one.** ⭐ The reason is precise and checkable: **all five owners of
`.changeset/*.md` ALSO declare the bare literal `.changeset`**, which `hintCovers` has always matched
against everything beneath it. ⇒ The brief was already naming all five families **through the sibling
literal**. ⛔ No dispatch was ever under-named on this account.

What *does* move: **548** `(family, card)` pairs re-attribute to a more precise printed key — all in
`release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test`, the one owner that spells the glob **before** the bare
literal — and **5 residue notes asserting a directory rename go to 0**.

⇒ ⭐ **Both halves of the card are real and both are repaired. It is only the blast-radius claim the
p1 rested on that the measurement contradicts.** ⛔ This seat does not re-grade — priority is
triage's field — so this is filed as a reading for the next grading, ⛔ not as a re-litigation.

### ⭐ And a second, ALREADY-LIVE instance the card did not know about

`scripts/*.d.mts` goes **0 → 4 tracked files**, and it was pinned **in this very file's own
self-test** as *"still dead"* until this change. ⇒ The gate was asserting a falsehood about itself and
its own suite agreed. Flagged for re-triage by the dev, ⛔ not re-litigated — correct.

### The mechanism, which is sharper than "the matcher can't follow a glob"

⭐ `collapseHint` **deletes** a glob. That is a sound reduction only when nothing but glob characters
follow it; when a **literal** follows, deletion is a **SPLICE** — `.changeset/*.md` becomes
`.changeset/.md`, a path that never existed. New `globCarriesLiteralSuffix` + `judgedAsPattern` route
that shape into the **existing** `zeroSegmentForms`/`triggerCovers` branch, ⛔ so there is no second
matching language to keep in sync.

**A2.4 answered, and it falsified my assumption in the useful direction**: `unreachableReason` **is** a
reason set (4 branches), ⛔ not a hard-coded string. The mismatch is **one level up** — `hintCovers`
has **two comparison modes** and the reason set covered one, so `deepestTrackedPrefix` /
`unreachableClass` / `unreachableReason` all reasoned from `collapseHint` **unconditionally**, and a
pattern-judged hint could never equal its own splice. ⇒ *"the layout moved under it"* was **the only
reachable sentence for the whole shape class**. New `comparedForm` makes each reason speak in the form
the comparison actually used, and ⭐ a pattern hint now gets **a checkable sentence naming the
`git ls-files` invocation that reproduces the emptiness** — a reason the reader can verify rather than
trust.

### The census is the deliverable, and it is a real one

**191 families × 749 distinct hints × 7588 tracked files**, with `before` produced by running **the
unfixed tool from an `origin/main` worktree over the identical corpus** — ⛔ not by reasoning about
what it would have done. `(hint,file)` pairs 35275 → 35823, `(gate,file)` pairs 140716 → 143456,
**zero lost**, **exactly one hint's reach changes**. `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` bit-for-bit unchanged.

**A2.2 answered with a bound**: exactly **one** hint in the whole fleet carries the missed shape, and
**zero** hints carry `?`, `+` or a character class anywhere ⇒ those are ⛔ deliberately **not**
admitted, and the self-test reds when one arrives. That is the "don't loosen until it looks
glob-ish" discipline, made mechanical.

⭐ **A2.1**: 548 at the dev's head — the fourth reading on the fourth day (~400 / 537 / 546 / 548).
